# Classic Chocolate Chip Cookie Recipe
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
This guide provides a classic chocolate chip cookie recipe, assuming standard kitchen equipment and common pantry staples. It yields soft, chewy cookies with crispy edges.

## Ingredients for Delicious Cookies
- 1/2 cup (113g) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup (100g) granulated sugar
- 1/4 cup (50g) packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 1/4 cups (150g) all-purpose flour
- 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1 cup (170g) semi-sweet chocolate chips

## Essential Baking Equipment
- Large mixing bowl
- Hand mixer or stand mixer
- Rubber spatula or wooden spoon
- Measuring cups and spoons
- Baking sheets
- Parchment paper or silicone baking mats
- Wire cooling rack

## Your Step-by-Step Baking Guide

### Step 1: Cream Butter and Sugars
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/hand-index.svg
- In a large bowl, cream together the softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until the mixture is light and fluffy. This usually takes about 2-3 minutes with an electric mixer.

### Step 2: Add Egg and Vanilla
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/egg.svg
- Beat in the large egg until just combined, then stir in the vanilla extract. Scrape down the sides of the bowl to ensure everything is well incorporated.

### Step 3: Combine Dry Ingredients
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-drizzle.svg
- In a separate medium bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, baking soda, and salt. This ensures the leavening agent is evenly distributed.

### Step 4: Mix Wet and Dry Ingredients
- Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing on low speed until just combined. Be careful not to overmix, as this can lead to tough cookies.

### Step 5: Fold in Chocolate Chips
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/droplet.svg
- Gently fold in the chocolate chips using a rubber spatula until they are evenly distributed throughout the dough.

### Step 6: Chill the Dough (Optional, but Recommended)
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/snow.svg
- For best results and chewier cookies, cover the bowl with plastic wrap and chill the dough in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes, or up to 24 hours. This helps prevent spreading.

### Step 7: Preheat Oven and Prepare Baking Sheets
- Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper or silicone baking mats.

### Step 8: Scoop and Bake
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cookie.svg
- Drop rounded tablespoons of cookie dough onto the prepared baking sheets, leaving about 2 inches between each cookie.
- Bake for 9-11 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the centers are still slightly soft.

### Step 9: Cool and Enjoy
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/grid.svg
- Let the cookies cool on the baking sheets for 2-3 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely. Enjoy your freshly baked chocolate chip cookies!

## Pro Tips for Success
- **Room Temperature Ingredients:** Ensure butter and egg are at room temperature for a smoother, more uniform dough.
- **Don't Overmix:** Overmixing develops gluten, which can make cookies tough. Mix until just combined.
- **Chill Time:** Chilling the dough solidifies the fat, preventing cookies from spreading too much and intensifying flavor.
- **Even Baking:** Rotate your baking sheets halfway through baking for uniform browning.
- **Storage:** Store cooled cookies in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3-4 days.
